title: As yet: пока не решено
description: As yet: пока не решено: чтение оригинального текста, контекстный словарь и точное описание ситуации с объяснениями ответов.
objectives: Найти в тексте ответ на вопрос «Что означало as yet unresolved?»
Различать значения unresolved и pending в теме «As yet: пока не решено»
notes: В предложении «The issue is as yet unresolved.» подлежащее в единственном числе согласуется с is.
При чтении важно сохранить факт или границу вывода: «A later finding remains possible but is not promised.»

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

Вставь слово из пары unresolved / pending. Значение: «Вопрос пока остаётся нерешённым.»

public_payload.passage: The panel described the source of the repeated delays as yet unresolved. A newspaper summary treated this as a verdict that the cause could never be discovered. Panel members objected to the change in time horizon. Their statement concerned the present state of the inquiry, not the permanent limits of knowledge. Several records had still to be examined, and competing explanations remained under consideration. The phrase as yet left room for a later finding without promising one. The corrected summary therefore retained both the current uncertainty and the ongoing investigation, avoiding an unsupported claim of either inevitable success or permanent impossibility.

options.label: Impossible to resolve at any future time.

exercises.explanation: Ответ подтверждён текстом: «Unresolved at the present stage.». Другие варианты изменяют указанное обстоятельство.
